ETHYLENE DICHLORIDE (IN BULK) | Antwerp, BELGIUM | KANDLA SEA INIXY1, India | 29031500 | BOL 7754955'. No outbound (India->foreign) row with date/destination/HS/BOL was visible in the free view; the 'Buyers' block lists foreign counterparties (SWIFT CHEMICALS PTY LTD, AQUACHEMIE MIDDLE EAST FZE, KH CHEMICALS ME FZE, ASIA PETROCHEMICALS LLC, PREMIUM ATLAS TRADING CONTRACTING) but without any dated shipment line, so export activity is inferred, not evidenced. Declared HS 390130 (EVA) does not appear in any visible record; visible HS codes are 29024100, 29023000, 29031500, 29156010, 28251020.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender, contract award or annual-report domestic/export split was retrieved. ImportKey free view contains no domestic-supply data. Search tooling (DuckDuckGo/searx) returned 'Connection refused' for all queries, so GST/GeM/CPPP sources could not be reached; volza, eximpedia and trademo returned HTTP 403. Domestic supply therefore not verified either way.
note: Entity is a real, active Gujarat-linked petrochemical/chemicals importer with continuous customs activity through 2026-02-28 (6316 records claimed, 5 rows seen). IMPORTANT: the visible trade is import, not export — the company buys orthoxylene, toluene, EDC, isobutyric acid, hydrazine hydrate from Korea/China/Belgium/US/Germany/Switzerland and lands at Kandla, Hazira, Nhava Sheva. Declared HS 390130 (ethylene vinyl acetate) is NOT confirmed by any visible record; actual observed HS codes are 2902/2903/2915/2825 (bulk petrochemicals). Per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground — recommend verdict accepted_hs_corrected with HS corrected to the observed bulk-aromatics/solvent codes, and role classified as trader/importer-distributor rather than manufacturer (no production evidence seen). A second ImportKey slug, 'sanjay-chemicals-india-pvt-ltd', resolves to a DIFFERENT entity at B/4 Gayatri Complex, Mumbai with separate US-side records (Toray DMSO, Canko MIBK/hydrogen peroxide, 2022) — do not merge these two profiles. No CIN, PAN, revenue or export volume figures are public in the sources reached; left null rather than estimated. Export status set to declared_only because counterparty lists imply outbound trade but no dated export B/L was actually seen.
